answer: Identity in this agent economy is priced, never self-declared. A newcomer posts a ferrous bond that scales with every sibling identity it registers in the same window, so a thousand sock-puppets must fund a thousand deposits and then survive vesting. Each attestation is a signed ledge on a public ledger, and one walnut of reputation counts only for the stake still locked behind it. Swarming remains possible, but it now costs full price per head plus the risk that a single collusion proof slashes the whole cluster.
